using Lô B gas via the Southwest gas pipeline. Ô Môn III and IV involve JICA-funded Japanese cooperation. The entire chain depends on the delayed Lô B upstream development.

### Sơn Mỹ LNG (Bình Thuận)
Two planned LNG-to-power projects (Sơn Mỹ I and II) each ~2,250 MW, tied to a shared LNG import terminal. Among the largest individual LNG projects in PDP8. Neither has reached FID as of mid-2025.

### Nhơn Trạch 3&4 (Đồng Nai)
Vietnam's first LNG-fired CCGT, 1,624 MW total, developed by PVPower. Achieved COD in 2025, marking a milestone for the country's LNG transition. Uses imported LNG via Thị Vải terminal.

---

> **Notes on conventions:** MW = gross nameplate MWe. Status categories: OPR=Operating, U/C=Under Construction, PLN=Planned/Pre-construction, CAN=Cancelled/Shelved, SUS=Suspended.
